archetype: 7 (Electric & Neon) - Custom Variant: Terminal Command Center

layout.grid_strategy: Control Room Protocol: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 or gap-6. Dense, data-heavy packing.
layout.spacing_scale: p-4 or p-6 for inner panel spacing. Avoid excessive whitespace; utilize screen real estate for logs, stats, and monitors.
layout.surface_style: Retro-Futurism / Terminal Look: No rounded corners (rounded-none). 1px crisp borders (border-green-500/20 or border-white/10). No soft shadows, replace with glowing drop-shadows on active states or 1px inner highlights.
layout.decorations: Use a subtle repeating-linear-gradient scanline overlay on terminal output areas or headers.

components.avatar_3d: Use `react-three-fiber` and `@react-three/drei`. Render an abstract wireframe core, sphere, or icosahedron. Map the rotation speed, pulse, and color to the agent's state (e.g., green + fast rotation = 'busy'; cyan + slow = 'idle'; red + static = 'offline').
components.dispatch_console: Prefix inputs with a hacker-style prompt (e.g., `user@nexus:~$ `). Use `JetBrains Mono`. On focus, add a glowing green ring and change text to high-saturation green.
components.forge_gallery: Dense bento-box grid for AI outputs. On hover, apply a `-translate-y-1` transform and a glowing green border (`border-green-500 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,255,65,0.3)]`).
components.operations_log: Scrolling monospace list. Color code text based on log severity (INFO: cyan, SUCCESS: green, ERROR: red). Bottom-up scrolling.
components.system_info_panel: Use sharp, cardless widgets or minimal 1px borders. Data bars for RAM/GPU should be solid high-contrast neon lines.

image_urls.description: Abstract lines and graphs with glowing green and blue effects
Abstract neon lines form a digital landscape
Abstract glowing lines and charts on white background

testing.rules: All interactive elements, forms, tabs, and critical status indicators MUST have a kebab-case, role-based `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='dispatch-submit-button'`, `data-testid='gpu-status-indicator'`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Import Google Fonts 'JetBrains Mono' and 'IBM Plex Sans' into index.css or index.html.
Install `@react-three/fiber`, `three`, and `@react-three/drei` for the 3D animated agent avatar.
Do NOT use rounded corners (`rounded-md`, `rounded-lg`). Force `rounded-none` on all Shadcn UI components to maintain the rigid terminal aesthetic.
Strictly follow the color scheme. Do not use generic 'blue' or 'indigo' from Tailwind. Stick to Terminal Green (#00FF41), Cyan, and Void Black (#050505).
Ensure hover states explicitly define text color to maintain APCA accessibility standards over dark backgrounds.
All grids must use `h-full` on children elements to ensure data panels align perfectly at the bottom without jagged edges.
